integrity: Self-contained analytic proof supported by a standalone finite checker. Finite tests are not a proof of infinite assertions. Research does not claim independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Marginal risk equality is for stationary FIFO arrival-indexed queues and independent infection labels. Conditional independence requires independent renewal future, labels and a fixed contact-duration threshold. The exact risk and conditional reversal concern stable M/D/1 with unit deterministic service, Poisson rate in (0,1), prevalence in (0,1) and threshold in (0,1). The earlier G/G/1 pairwise overlap law and related maximal-overlap statements are prior results. Independence and identical distribution are distinct assertions. The first-public date is from the first arXiv version; it is not a journal publication date. No independent priority audit has been performed.
title: Arrival-index duality and conditional exposure reversal in FIFO queues
